decks.notes: This deck focuses on quickly filling up the graveyard with spells to bring back Arclight Phoenix as a recurring threat. The deck includes a mix of card draw, spell recursion, and removal spells to support the Aggro strategy. The aim is to cast multiple spells in a turn to trigger Arclight Phoenix's ability and put pressure on the opponent. The deck aims to win through a combination of swift damage from Arclight Phoenix and burn spells like Lightning Axe and Fiery Impulse. The lands are designed to support the deck's mana requirements and ensure consistency in gameplay.

The main concept of this deck is to quickly ramp up mana with cards like Llanowar Elves, Elvish Mystic, and Nykthos, Shrine to Nyx to play powerful green creatures and planeswalkers early in the game. The deck utilizes cards like Storm the Festival to search for key creatures and Wolfwillow Haven to generate additional mana. Elder Gargaroth and Old-Growth Troll are key threats that can quickly end the game if not dealt with. The deck also includes cards like Cavalier of Thorns and Kiora, Behemoth Beckoner to increase card advantage and provide additional utility.

The main focus of this deck is to utilize sacrifice effects and card advantage to overwhelm the opponent with aggressive plays. By sacrificing creatures like Cauldron Familiar and utilizing cards like Village Rites and Deadly Dispute, the deck aims to control the board and generate value through triggers like Mayhem Devil and Voldaren Epicure. The inclusion of Ob Nixilis, the Adversary provides additional removal and card advantage, while the mana base is designed to support the deck's aggressive strategy. Jegantha, the Wellspring is included as a companion to provide additional utility and consistency.

The main focus of this deck is to maintain a fast-paced aggressive strategy by playing low-cost Spirits and leveraging cards that provide tempo advantage. The key strategy involves utilizing cheap disruptive spells like Spell Pierce and Geistlight Snare to control the opponent's plays while building a board presence with creatures like Supreme Phantom and Shacklegeist. Curious Obsession can help draw additional cards to maintain pressure, while creatures like Ascendant Spirit can grow in power over time. Faceless Haven provides a versatile threat, and the inclusion of snow-covered lands helps enable this land-dependent strategy.

The deck focuses on controlling the opponent's board and hand, using a combination of removal spells, counterspells, and card advantage engines. With a strong mana base, it aims to stabilize the game with board wipes like Supreme Verdict and draw spells like Memory Deluge. Teferi, Hero of Dominaria and Yorion, Sky Nomad provide additional value and control options. Overall, the deck aims to outvalue the opponent and grind out a win through careful decision-making and resource management.

This Esper Control deck focuses on controlling the game by utilizing a variety of removal spells, counter spells, and card advantage engines to out-value and outlast opponents. With a combination of powerful planeswalkers like Teferi, Hero of Dominaria and versatile removal spells like Fatal Push and Vanishing Verse, the deck aims to disrupt opponents' strategies while building towards a win condition. The addition of Yorion, Sky Nomad as a companion allows for additional value through blinking permanents for card advantage and board control, adding an extra layer of resilience to the deck.

This Rakdos Aggro deck focuses on aggressive gameplay, utilizing powerful creatures like Kroxa, Titan of Death's Hunger and Bonecrusher Giant, backed up by removal spells such as Fatal Push and Dreadbore. The deck aims to disrupt the opponent's hand with cards like Thoughtseize while also taking advantage of graveyard interactions with cards like Kalitas, Traitor of Ghet and Graveyard Trespasser. With a mix of burn spells, efficient creatures, and hand disruption, this deck aims to maintain constant pressure on the opponent and close out the game quickly.

This Rakdos Aggro deck focuses on utilizing a combination of powerful creatures and removal spells to apply early pressure on the opponent. The deck aims to disrupt the opponent's game plan with cards like Thoughtseize and Fatal Push, while also deploying threats such as Bonecrusher Giant and Bloodtithe Harvester to quickly end the game. The inclusion of cards like Kroxa, Titan of Death's Hunger and Graveyard Trespasser allows the deck to maintain a strong presence in the late game, ensuring that it can close out matches efficiently.

This Boros Aggro deck focuses on quickly building up a board presence and using combat tricks to push through damage. With cards like Ancestral Anger and Defiant Strike, the deck aims to buff up its creatures and protect them with spells like Gods Willing. The inclusion of Jegantha, the Wellspring as a companion adds an extra element of versatility to the deck. By maintaining a balance of aggression and protection, this deck aims to overwhelm the opponent with a fast and relentless assault.

The deck focuses on using Indomitable Creativity to turn low-cost tokens into powerful creatures like Hornet Queen or Shark Typhoon. It also includes cards like Vampires' Vengeance and Prismari Command for removal and control, while utilizing dig spells like Dig Through Time and Opt for card advantage. The mana base includes a mix of lands to ensure access to all colors needed for the combo. The deck aims to be flexible and creative in its approach, while still maintaining a strong win condition through the combo interactions.

The main strategy of this deck is to aggressively ramp into high mana Green creatures and planeswalkers, utilizing devotion to Green to further power up the deck. The focus is on quickly getting out strong creatures like Topiary Stomper and Old-Growth Troll, while also utilizing ramp cards like Llanowar Elves and Elvish Mystic to accelerate the mana base. The deck also includes powerful planeswalkers like Nissa, Who Shakes the World and Kiora, Behemoth Beckoner to provide additional value and support for the aggressive creatures. Overall, the deck aims to overwhelm the opponent with big, powerful creatures and planeswalkers.

The main concept of this deck is to quickly build up devotion to green mana symbols on the battlefield while aggressively pushing for early game aggression. Utilizing a mix of mana dorks, ramp spells, and powerful green creatures, the deck aims to overwhelm opponents before they can stabilize. The inclusion of cards like Storm the Festival and Nykthos, Shrine to Nyx enables explosive turns where the player can flood the board with threats. Additionally, the deck features some control elements with cards like Karn, the Great Creator and Sylvan Caryatid to provide some versatility in different matchups.

This deck focuses on playing a fast and aggressive game with a Human tribal theme. By utilizing cards like General Kudro of Drannith, Thalia, Guardian of Thraben, and Thalia's Lieutenant, the deck aims to swarm the board with efficient creatures and pump them up to overwhelm the opponent. Collected Company helps to dig for more threats and put them directly into play, while Reflector Mage provides tempo by bouncing opposing threats. The mana base is optimized for consistency and mana fixing to ensure smooth gameplay.

The concept of this deck is to control the game with a diverse mix of versatile cards, while also utilizing Niv-Mizzet Reborn's ability to draw a wide range of powerful multicolored cards. The deck includes various removal spells, counter spells, and versatile threats to disrupt the opponent's game plan and outvalue them in the late game. The mana base is built to support Niv-Mizzet's ability and ensure consistency in casting the wide array of multicolored spells in the deck. Overall, the deck aims to control the game and overwhelm the opponent with its diverse and powerful cards.

The main focus of this deck is to overwhelm the opponent with a quick and aggressive approach while controlling the pace of the game through tempo plays. By utilizing low-cost Spirit creatures and disruptive spells, the deck aims to establish early board presence and maintain pressure on the opponent. Cards like Brazen Borrower and Shacklegeist provide versatile options for dealing with threats, while cards like Curious Obsession and Ascendant Spirit help to maintain card advantage and power up the creatures on the battlefield. Additionally, the inclusion of snow-covered lands enables powerful synergies with Faceless Haven.

The main idea of this deck is to quickly establish a board presence with aggressive Azorius spirits and use tempo plays to control the game. By utilizing evasive creatures like Spectral Sailor and Supreme Phantom in combination with disruptive spells like Shacklegeist and Geistlight Snare, the deck aims to apply pressure while disrupting the opponent's game plan. The inclusion of cards like Brazen Borrower and Ascendant Spirit provide additional versatility and threats, giving the deck multiple avenues to victory. Overall, the deck focuses on tempo and aggression to overwhelm opponents in the Pioneer format.
